pathIdentity.result: Each constructed variant refuses before worktree creation without branch or registration residue. Existing mode-000 directories refuse; canonical whitespace-ending directories pass the identity guards. A Git-registered variant yields one named beacon refusal while a healthy row and group cache remain readable. On a second registered worktree, a mode-000 beacon directory, a searchable but unlistable one and a sealed parent each yield that row's refusal with its directory and reason while the healthy row is swept; single-root guards refuse naming the directory.

restartEvidence: Real SIGKILL after all 14 durable completed steps and between completion-event append and receipt projection; every restart preserves earlier receipts and command/episode identities, dispatches no effect twice, and restores all 14 receipt files.

earlierAttempts.reason: The new table found that a bare verb after 'but' ('should work but fail') was read as an imperative in a requirement statement; the rule now opens an imperative only at a sentence start, after a colon, or after another imperative or a leading condition. The recovery fixture found that the forge double reported one fixed update time; the double now takes it from its fixture file.

Two new fixtures reset the shared fixture clock backwards between modes and one asserted the restart replay on the first idle tick instead of at most once; both fixtures were corrected. No production branch changed for either.

limits: The SIGKILL driver uses pure execution ports. Production primitive composition and resident entry restarts are separately exercised with synthetic external actors. External success before its durable completion receipt remains outside this recovery guarantee. The backoff and finished-continuation memory are process-local.
